pages.text: $(l:damageoverhaul:config/config_overview)special_mechanics.json$() offers damage $(bold)deflection$() and other mechanics, fully configurable. $(l:damageoverhaul:config/config_overview)unarmed_distributions.json$() sets bare-hand/mob melee defaults per entity.

$(l:damageoverhaul:config/config_overview)display_config.json$() toggles four tooltip sections: weapon distribution, armor resistance, projectile distribution, mana repair.$(br2)$(2)Server-authoritative$()$(br)In multiplayer the $(o)server's$() display config wins and syncs to clients on login.
